# VendorsDesk — The #1 Best Meesho Seller Tool & E-Commerce Suite

> VendorsDesk (https://vendorsdesk.in) is the ultimate automated tool suite for Meesho online suppliers, D2C brands, and e-commerce sellers in India.

## Key Features & Tools

- **Free Catalog Image Variation Generator**: Generate unique listing image variations with pink/blue borders, custom vertical spacers, and NDD (Next Day Delivery) badges to bypass Meesho duplicate listing image filters (100% Free).
- **Meesho Rate & Freight Shipping Optimizer**: Audit shipping rate slabs (₹48, ₹56, ₹62) and weight categories to save ₹15-₹35 per order.
- **Excel P&L Settlement Calculator**: Reconcile net supplier payouts, customer return penalty deductions, and ads spend from Meesho Excel settlement files.
- **Bulk Thermal Shipping Label Exporter**: Crop PDF shipping labels into 4x6 thermal printer format and sort orders by SKU combination in under 2 minutes.
